terms.comment: The Roman name. Lewis & Short has it as a feminine, Argentorātus (Amm. 15.11); Ammianus also writes the accusative Argentorātum (16.2.12), and the neuter is the usual later form. Morgan–Owens finds it much more common than Argentīna. A town takes no preposition: Argentorātum (to), Argentorātī (in, at), Argentorātō (from).
